tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password. The endpoint should validate the email and password, and reject registration if the email is already in use. The endpoint should return a success message if the registration is successful.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the registration endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given an invalid email, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given a password with less than 8 characters, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given an email that is already in use, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Store passwords using bcrypt hashing. Never store or log plaintext passwords. The password hashing should be done when a user registers or updates their password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user registration, when the password is stored, then it is hashed using bcrypt.
Given a password update, when the password is stored, then it is hashed using bcrypt.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry. The frontend attaches this token to subsequent authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then it contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when it is used to make an authenticated request, then the request is successful.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then the token is no longer valid.
Given an invalid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for auth endpoints
tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints. The tests should cover both successful and failed scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.

tasks.summary: Write integration tests for auth flow
tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the full authentication flow, including registration, login, and logout. The tests should cover both successful and failed scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
